name: BeLive Holdings Ordinary Share
summary: BeLive Holdings is a company focused on software development and programming, also providing expert advisory services. It designs and implements technology solutions specifically tailored for live commerce and interactive short videos that facilitate direct purchasing. The company's offerings are accessible through its customizable BeLive White Label platform and its cloud-hosted BeLive Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution. Founded in Singapore in 2014, BeLive Holdings continues to operate from its headquarters in the city-state.
